title: C4OS Grill Question 003 - Tool View Selection
notes_or_corrections:
From my original task list:

```
- Frontend - No right panel by default. One singular header (with plugin icons to the far left or right based on each config. Ability to reorder icons.). Clicking plugin icons will toggle show the plugin panel view. Clicking an active plugin icon will close the relative panel view. Both active left and right panel should be able resize up to the center pane fixed minimum width (set a fix minimum width for center pane)
```

What that means is it's possible to have more than one plugin to use the same Tauri tool, depends on what is the active plugin in the panel view (left or right). If there is a browser plugin (browser-1) on the left and active and another different browser plugin (browser-2) on the right panel, then saying "load x.com in browser" should load x.com on both browser plugins.

Let me know if there are discrepencies with this because im just answering hypotheticals on the fly.

schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 003 - Tool View Selection

questions.label: When multiple app plugins support the same Tauri tool, how should C4OS choose the view?
questions.help: Recommended: let the user choose a default view per tool, with plugin priority only as the initial fallback. This supports replacing the default Browser plugin without coupling tool authority to one app plugin.
options: User chooses default view per tool; plugin priority is fallback
Highest-priority enabled plugin always owns the tool view
Runtime chooses the view from available plugin metadata
Show all compatible views every time
